title: Traditional Portuguese Beef Feijoada
description: A hearty, comforting Portuguese stew made with beef and beans, perfect for a cold winter's night.

ingredients.name: Beef brisket, cut into small pieces
Red wine
ingredients.notes: Can be substituted with beef broth

instructions: In a large Dutch oven or pot, heat some oil over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the beef pieces and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the soaked and drained black beans, red wine, beef broth, salt, and black pepper.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 2 hours.
Add the tomato paste and stir to combine.
Continue to simmer, covered, for another 30 minutes, or until the beef is tender.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley or cilantro, if desired.
